about: Trade-dress checklist (design.md, The robots; Legal and taste): every robot and vehicle model, its recorded silhouette, and the nearest real products and film robots it must not copy. Comparisons are the asset author's, from general knowledge, with no image search; the user signs each one off before release. tests/assets/trade-dress.test.ts fails when a robot or vehicle model has no entry.

entries.name: Porter
entries.maker: Bramblecot Home (name search pending in content/cleared-names.json)
entries.silhouette: Tall (1.95 m), slim, artist's-mannequin proportions: a glazed white ceramic vase torso with a bronze seam, graphite ball joints, long tapered limbs, rounded boots, three-finger hands. The head is a lantern: a bulging barrel with six bronze ribs, a cap, a finial and a carrying ring; one soft warm light strip across the front. Fully opaque; no face plate, no visor, no screen.

nearest.what: Film robot with a translucent face and torso (2004 feature)
nearest.difference: No translucent parts anywhere (test: every material opaque); the head is a lantern, not a human-shaped face.

nearest.what: Humanoid robots with a black visor face plate (2020s commercial humanoids)
nearest.difference: No visor: the face is a single thin horizontal light strip on a white lantern barrel.

nearest.what: Small white astronaut-style humanoid with a backpack (2000s research robot)
nearest.difference: No backpack, no helmet dome, twice as slim and much taller.

nearest.what: Inflatable white care robot (2014 animated film)
nearest.difference: Hard glazed ceramic segments and visible joints; slim, not round.
Deliberate reference (generic, not a product); the lantern head and bronze trim make it its own.

entries.name: Trundle
entries.silhouette: Knee-high (0.56 m) bread bin on four wheels: a cream box whose front top is a quarter-round closed by a sage-green slatted roll-top lid that rolls back into the body; graphite bumper band and fender skirts; one soft light strip along the front lip under the lid (light_face) and a camera slot in the bumper. No flag, no whip antenna, no hinged lid, no pair of eye lights.

nearest.what: Six-wheeled white sidewalk delivery robot with a hinged lid and an orange flag on a whip antenna
nearest.difference: Four wheels, a roll-top (tambour) lid, no flag or antenna (tests check both).

nearest.what: Four-wheeled sidewalk delivery robots with two round LED 'eyes' on the front and a hinged top lid (the closest real cue)
nearest.difference: No eyes: one wide light strip along the lip, like a bread bin's handle line, and the camera low in the bumper (a test checks there is a single centred strip over 0.3 m wide). The lid is a roll-top that rolls back inside the body, not a hinged lid; the front is a quarter-round bread-bin profile in cream and sage, not a box.

nearest.what: Four-wheeled sidewalk robots shaped like coolers, some with a face screen
nearest.difference: A bread-bin profile with a quarter-round front and a slatted roll-top; no screen, no cooler lid.

entries.name: Moat Labs van
entries.silhouette: Tall, faceted, driverless box van (5.8 x 2.1 x 2.5 m) in graphite: chamfered keep-like corners, a battlement of small blocks along both roof edges, narrow vertical slit lamps at the corners, a teal moat band and light line along the sills, a castle-over-water emblem in geometry, rear barn doors, camera pods instead of mirrors.

nearest.difference: Faceted body with chamfered upper corners, roof battlements, slit lamps; no grille shape or badge of any maker.

nearest.what: Electric delivery vans with a full-width front light bar
nearest.difference: No light bar: two narrow vertical slit lamps per corner.
Satirical castle styling, no armour plating or gun-port shapes; driverless, camera pods.

entries.name: Meander robotaxi
entries.silhouette: Tall, two-ended carriage pod (4.96 x 1.92 m, 1.95 m to the roof, 2.02 m to its pods; 3.40 m wheelbase, 0.38 m wheels at the corners) in warm white, the same both ways round: bowed ends of big glass, rounded plan corners each with a slim white post the glass wraps round, dark cladding along the sills, a light bar across each end in a dark housing (white at the front, red at the back). One dark sensor band round the roof edge with a teal status line (light_status) in it, and a low white lantern pod with a dark lens ring and a teal ring on each roof corner. Kerb side (right): one wide sliding door (door_slide_R) in the middle with dark posts at its edges. Street side (left): no door, two windows either side of a white post, a charging flap. No grille, badge, text or livery.

nearest.what: Purpose-built bidirectional robotaxi pods of the 2020s (boxy, the same both ways round, a light bar at each end, sensors at the four roof corners, doors on both sides)
nearest.difference: The genre the owner asked for (2026-10-27, "bigger Zoox or something"), drawn as Fog City's own: a longer carriage (4.96 m) rather than a short cube; a white roof and white corner posts with the glass wrapping round them, not a dark glass top; the Meander's dark sensor band with its teal status line round the roof edge; low white lantern pods with a dark lens ring sitting on the roof corners, not dark housings that form the corners; one sliding door on the kerb side only and a white post between the street side's windows (tested: different each side); no logo, name or livery.

nearest.what: Production robotaxis built on crossover and SUV bodies with a spinning roof dome (the wave-1 model's shape)
nearest.difference: No dome, roof rack or mirror cameras: nothing stands on the roof but the four corner pods (tested), and the body is a purpose-built pod, not a converted car.

nearest.what: Driverless shuttles and small electric buses (2010s-2020s)
nearest.difference: Car-sized (inside the 5.0 x 2.0 m traffic box) with the wheels at the corners, not a bus's overhangs; one door, not two; no destination sign, route display or ramp.

nearest.what: Minivans and compact MPVs with sliding doors
nearest.difference: No bonnet, no driver's door, no windscreen wipers; the same both ways round; no grille or badge.

entries.name: The Hatch (player car)
entries.silhouette: An orange five-door hatchback (4.3 m), lofted body, round wheel arches, no badge.

nearest.difference: Generic proportions, invented light bars, no grille or badge; reviewed in wave 1.

entries.name: Muni bus
entries.maker: the city's transit agency (real name: pre-release legal checklist)
entries.silhouette: A 12.5 m city bus, red lower body, a large livery panel per side for generated ads, destination sign.

nearest.what: SF Muni buses and their livery
nearest.difference: On the pre-release legal checklist (design.md): the Muni name and livery.

entries.name: Generic civilian fastback
entries.silhouette: Original unbranded four-door fastback with rounded blue-gray body, tapered greenhouse, separate conventional lamps and grille, anonymous glyph plate; 4.36 m overall length.

nearest.difference: Generic vehicle proportions with original panel, light and grille geometry; no copied model, logo, badge, livery or real registration.

entries.signOff: Original mesh reviewed in SF realism pass; no branded source asset.
